literal: Gaozong, Emperor Wencheng, bore the taboo name Jun; he was Gongzong, Emperor Jingmu's eldest son.
idiomatic: Gaozong, Emperor Wencheng, bore the taboo name Jun. He was the eldest son of Gongzong, Emperor Jingmu.

literal: His mother was the Lu clan; in the sixth month of the first year of Zhenjun he was born in the Eastern Palace.
idiomatic: His mother was of the Lu clan. In the sixth month of the first year of Zhenjun he was born in the Eastern Palace.

literal: The Emperor in youth was quick and penetrating; Shizu loved him, constantly kept him at his side, and styled him Heir of the World, Imperial Grandson.
idiomatic: As a boy he was quick and penetrating. Shizu loved him, kept him constantly at his side, and styled him Heir of the World, Imperial Grandson.

literal: At age five, when Shizu toured the north, the Emperor followed behind; they met a barbarian commander fettering a slave and about to punish him.
idiomatic: At the age of five, when Shizu toured the north, the boy followed behind. They met a barbarian commander who had bound a slave and was about to punish him.

literal: The Emperor said to him: "This slave has now met me—you ought to release him.
idiomatic: The boy said to him, "This slave has met me now—you should release him.

literal: " The commander obeyed the command and undid the bonds.
idiomatic: " The commander obeyed and untied him.

literal: Shizu heard of it and said: "Though this child is small, he wishes to comport himself as Son of Heaven.
idiomatic: When Shizu heard of it he said, "Though this child is small, he means to comport himself as Son of Heaven.

literal: " He regarded it as extraordinary.
idiomatic: " He marveled at it.

literal: When he had grown, his bearing was unusual; whenever there was great policy he often joined in deciding yes or no.
idiomatic: When he had grown, his bearing was unusual. Whenever major policy was at stake he often took part in deciding it.

literal: Tenth month of the second year of Zhengping, day wushen: he assumed the imperial throne in the front hall of Yong'an; a general amnesty; the era name was changed.
idiomatic: In the tenth month of the second year of Zhengping, on the wushen day, he took the throne in the front hall of Yong'an, proclaimed a general amnesty, and changed the era name.

literal: Tenth month of the first year of Xing'an: General of Agile Cavalry Yuan Shoule was made Grand Preceptor, Commander-in-Chief of All Armies Within and Without, and Recorder of Secretariat Affairs;
idiomatic: In the tenth month of the first year of Xing'an, General of Agile Cavalry Yuan Shoule was made Grand Preceptor, Commander-in-Chief of All Armies Within and Without, and Recorder of Secretariat Affairs;

literal: Changsun Kehou of the Secretariat was made Director of the Secretariat, with added Three-Director Equipage.
idiomatic: Changsun Kehou of the Secretariat was made Director of the Secretariat, with the added rank of Three-Director Equipage.

literal: Eleventh month, day bingzi: the two contended for power and were both ordered to die.
idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the bingzi day, the two contended for power and were both ordered to die.

literal: Day guiwei: Prince of Guangyang Jian died; Prince of Huai'nan Tan died.
idiomatic: On the guiwei day Prince of Guangyang Jian died, and Prince of Huai'nan Tan died.

literal: Day jiashen: the imperial mother died.
idiomatic: On the jiashen day the imperial mother died.

literal: Grand Commandant Zhang Li and Minister of Works Gu Bi, because their counsel did not accord with the imperial will, were demoted to Outer Metropolitan Officials.
idiomatic: Grand Commandant Zhang Li and Minister of Works Gu Bi, because their counsel did not accord with the imperial will, were demoted to Outer Metropolitan Officials.

literal: General Who Pacifies the South, Marquis of Songzi Zhou Niu, was advanced in rank to Prince of Leling; Minister of the South, Viscount of Zhang'an Lu Li, was made Prince of Pingyuan; civil and military officials each received one step in rank.
idiomatic: Zhou Niu, General Who Pacifies the South and Marquis of Songzi, was advanced to Prince of Leling; Lu Li, Minister of the South and Viscount of Zhang'an, was made Prince of Pingyuan; civil and military officials each rose one rank.

literal: Day renyin: posthumously honored Crown Prince Jingmu as Emperor Jingmu and the imperial mother as Empress Gong;
idiomatic: On the renyin day Crown Prince Jingmu was posthumously honored as Emperor Jingmu and the imperial mother as Empress Gong;

literal: the wet-nurse, the Chang clan, was honored as Empress Dowager Protector.
idiomatic: the wet-nurse of the Chang clan was honored as Empress Dowager Protector.

literal: Jingwen, king of the Tuge in Longxi, rebelled; an edict ordered the commander of Tongwan garrison, Prince of Nanyang Huishou, to suppress and pacify him.
idiomatic: Jingwen, king of the Tuge in Longxi, rebelled. An edict ordered Prince of Nanyang Huishou, commander of Tongwan garrison, to suppress and pacify him.

literal: Twelfth month, day wushen: associated burial of Empress Gong at Jinling.
idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the wushen day, Empress Gong was associated in burial at Jinling.

literal: Day yimao: Buddhism was first restored.
idiomatic: On the yimao day the Buddhist faith was restored for the first time.

literal: Day dingsi: Prince of Leling Zhou Niu was made Grand Commandant; Prince of Pingyuan Lu Li was made Minister of Works; General Who Guards the West Du Yuanbao was made Minister of the Masses.
idiomatic: On the dingsi day Prince of Leling Zhou Niu was made Grand Commandant, Prince of Pingyuan Lu Li Minister of Works, and General Who Guards the West Du Yuanbao Minister of the Masses.

literal: Baoda and the state of Shalie each sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: Baoda and the state of Shalie each sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Day wuyin: Duke of Jianye Lu Hou was advanced to Prince of Dongping; Duke of Guangping Du Yi was advanced to prince.
idiomatic: On the wuyin day Duke of Jianye Lu Hou was advanced to Prince of Dongping and Duke of Guangping Du Yi was advanced to prince.

literal: Day guihai: an edict, because of locusts in Yingzhou, ordered granaries opened for relief.
idiomatic: On the guihai day, because of locusts in Yingzhou, an edict ordered granaries opened for relief.

literal: Day jiazi: Grand Commandant, Prince of Leling Zhou Niu, was guilty and ordered to die.
idiomatic: On the jiazi day Grand Commandant Zhou Niu, Prince of Leling, was found guilty and ordered to die.

literal: Duke of Puyang Lu Ruowen was advanced to prince.
idiomatic: Duke of Puyang Lu Ruowen was advanced to prince.

literal: Second year, spring, first month, day xinsi: Minister of the Masses Du Yuanbao was advanced to Prince of Jingzhao.
idiomatic: In the first month of spring of the second year, on the xinsi day, Minister of the Masses Du Yuanbao was advanced to Prince of Jingzhao.

literal: Prince of Guangping Du Yi died.
idiomatic: Prince of Guangping Du Yi died.

literal: Vice Director of the Secretariat, Duke of Dong'an Liu Ni, was advanced to prince.
idiomatic: Liu Ni, Vice Director of the Secretariat and Duke of Dong'an, was advanced to prince.

literal: Li, son of Prince of Jianning Chong, was enfeoffed as Prince of Jinan.
idiomatic: Li, son of Prince of Jianning Chong, was enfeoffed as Prince of Jinan.

literal: Day guiwei: an edict imposed miscellaneous levies on the people of fifteen.
idiomatic: On the guiwei day an edict imposed miscellaneous levies on the people of fifteen.

literal: Day bingxu: Director of the Secretariat, Duke of Xiping Yuan He, was advanced to prince.
idiomatic: On the bingxu day Yuan He, Director of the Secretariat and Duke of Xiping, was advanced to prince.

literal: Second month, day jiwei: Minister of the Masses, Prince of Jingzhao Du Yuanbao, plotted rebellion and was executed;
idiomatic: In the second month, on the jiwei day, Minister of the Masses Du Yuanbao, Prince of Jingzhao, plotted rebellion and was executed;

literal: Prince of Jianning Chong and Chong's son Prince of Jinan Li, implicated by Yuanbao, were each ordered to die.
idiomatic: Prince of Jianning Chong and his son Li, Prince of Jinan, implicated by Yuanbao, were each ordered to die.

literal: Day yichou: five thousand men from the capital were sent to dig the Tianyuan Pool.
idiomatic: On the yichou day five thousand men from the capital were sent to dig the Tianyuan Pool.

literal: That month Liu Yilong's son Shao killed his father and installed himself.
idiomatic: That month Liu Yilong's son Shao killed his father and seized the throne.

literal: Third month, day renwu: Empress Dowager Protector was honored as Empress Dowager.
idiomatic: In the third month, on the renwu day, the Empress Dowager Protector was honored as Empress Dowager.

literal: Duke of Anfeng Lu Hupi was advanced to Prince of Hejian.
idiomatic: Duke of Anfeng Lu Hupi was advanced to Prince of Hejian.

literal: Day yiwei: the state of Shule sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On the yiwei day the state of Shule sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Summer, fifth month, day yiyou: the imperial carriage traveled to Mount Guo.
idiomatic: In the fifth month of summer, on the yiyou day, the emperor went to Mount Guo.

literal: Day xinmao: returned to the palace.
idiomatic: On the xinmao day he returned to the palace.

literal: That month Liu Shao's younger brother Jun killed Shao and installed himself.
idiomatic: That month Liu Shao's younger brother Liu Jun killed Shao and seized the throne.

literal: Intercalary month, day yihai: Grand Empress Dowager Helian died.
idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on the yihai day, Grand Empress Dowager Helian died.

literal: Autumn, seventh month, day xinhai: the imperial carriage traveled to Yinshan.
idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the xinhai day, the emperor went to Yinshan.

literal: Prince of Puyang Lu Ruowen and General Who Conquers the West, Prince of Yongchang Ren, plotted rebellion.
idiomatic: Prince of Puyang Lu Ruowen and Ren, General Who Conquers the West and Prince of Yongchang, plotted rebellion.

literal: Day yichou: Ren was ordered to die at Chang'an; Ruowen was executed.
idiomatic: On the yichou day Ren was ordered to die at Chang'an; Ruowen was executed.

literal: Day jisi: the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
idiomatic: On the jisi day the court returned to the palace.

literal: That month a horse-shooting terrace was built at the southern suburb.
idiomatic: That month a horse-shooting terrace was built at the southern suburb.

literal: Eighth month, day xinwei: the state of Kapisa sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the xinwei day, the state of Kapisa sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Day wuxu: an edict said: "We, in our slight person, have succeeded to the great enterprise, fearing we cannot spread kindness, harmony, and peace, and settle the myriad realms—day and night we are cautious, as if facing a deep ravine.
idiomatic: On the wuxu day an edict said, "We, in our slight person, have succeeded to the great enterprise and fear we cannot spread kindness, harmony, and peace to settle the myriad realms. Day and night we are cautious, as if facing a deep ravine.

literal: Yet since assuming the throne the common people are at ease, wind and rain are in order, the borders are without incident, and many auspices together appear beyond counting.
idiomatic: Yet since assuming the throne the people are at ease, wind and rain are in order, the borders are quiet, and auspicious signs have appeared beyond counting.

literal: Moreover within the park a square-inch jade seal was obtained, its inscription reading 'Long life for sons and grandsons'; the assembled dukes, ministers, and scholars all said 'How excellent!'
idiomatic: Moreover, within the park a square-inch jade seal was found inscribed 'Long life for sons and grandsons,' and the assembled dukes, ministers, and scholars all cried, 'How excellent!'

literal: How could We alone attain such a response—it is truly because Heaven, Earth, and the ancestors bestowed blessing.
idiomatic: How could we alone attain such a response? It is truly because Heaven, Earth, and the ancestors bestowed their blessing.

literal: We think to share this fine celebration with the myriad people: let the people feast for three days; all below extraordinary death each have crimes reduced one degree.
idiomatic: We wish to share this fine celebration with the myriad people: let the people feast for three days, and let all below extraordinary death have their crimes reduced one degree.

literal: " Ninth month, day renzi: reviewed arms at the southern suburb.
idiomatic: " In the ninth month, on the renzi day, arms were reviewed at the southern suburb.

literal: Winter, eleventh month, day xinyou: traveled to Xinzhou and Zhongshan to observe local customs.
idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter, on the xinyou day, the emperor went to Xinzhou and Zhongshan to observe local customs.

literal: Twelfth month: bandits among the people of Hejian and Mo were executed; males fifteen and under were taken as living booty and distributed to followers, each according to rank.
idiomatic: In the twelfth month bandits among the people of Hejian and Mo were executed; males fifteen and under were taken as living booty and distributed to followers according to rank.

literal: Day jiawu: the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
idiomatic: On the jiawu day the court returned to the palace.

literal: Kumo Xi, Khitan, Kapisa, and more than ten other states each sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: Kumo Xi, Khitan, Kapisa, and more than ten other states each sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Duke of Beiping Changsun Dun's princely rank was restored.
idiomatic: Duke of Beiping Changsun Dun's princely rank was restored.

literal: The text is deficient.
idiomatic: The text is deficient.

literal: First year of Xingguang, spring, first month, day yichou: Palace Attendant, Duke of Henan Yi Ba, was made Minister of the Masses.
idiomatic: In the first month of spring of the first year of Xingguang, on the yichou day, Palace Attendant Yi Ba, Duke of Henan, was made Minister of the Masses.

literal: Second month, day jiawu: the Emperor came to the Dao altar and ascended to receive the registers and tallies;
idiomatic: In the second month, on the jiawu day, the emperor came to the Dao altar and ascended to receive the registers and tallies;

literal: when the rites were complete, a partial amnesty in the capital and distributions of rewards, each according to rank.
idiomatic: when the rites were complete there was a partial amnesty in the capital and rewards were distributed according to rank.

literal: Summer, sixth month, day bingyin: the imperial carriage traveled to Yinshan.
idiomatic: In the sixth month of summer, on the bingyin day, the emperor went to Yinshan.

literal: Autumn, seventh month, day gengzi: the imperial son Hong was born.
idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the gengzi day, the imperial son Hong was born.

literal: Day xinchou: a general amnesty; the era name was changed.
idiomatic: On the xinchou day there was a general amnesty and the era name was changed.

literal: Eighth month, day jiaxu: Prince of Zhao Shen died.
idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the jiaxu day, Prince of Zhao Shen died.

literal: Day yihai: the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
idiomatic: On the yihai day the court returned to the palace.

literal: Day yichou: the imperial uncles Hutou and Longtou died.
idiomatic: On the yichou day the imperial uncles Hutou and Longtou died.

literal: Ninth month, day gengshen: the state of Kumo Xi presented a famous horse with one horn, shaped like a qilin.
idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the gengshen day, the state of Kumo Xi presented a famous horse with one horn, shaped like a qilin.

literal: That month the capital gates were closed and a great search lasted three days; several hundred adulterers and fugitives were seized.
idiomatic: That month the capital gates were closed and a great search lasted three days; several hundred adulterers and fugitives were seized.

literal: Winter, eleventh month: the northern garrison general Fang Zhang attacked the Rouran, captured their generals Douhun and Gou and others, and obtained more than a thousand horses.
idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter the northern garrison general Fang Zhang attacked the Rouran, captured their generals Douhun, Gou, and others, and took more than a thousand horses.

literal: Day wuxu: the imperial carriage traveled to Zhongshan, then to Xinzhou.
idiomatic: On the wuxu day the emperor went to Zhongshan, then to Xinzhou.

literal: Twelfth month, day bingzi: returned to Lingqiu, reaching the Hot Springs Palace.
idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the bingzi day, he returned to Lingqiu and reached the Hot Springs Palace.

literal: Day gengchen: the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
idiomatic: On the gengchen day the court returned to the palace.

literal: The states of Chuyu and Chiwandan each sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: The states of Chuyu and Chiwandan each sent envoys with tribute.

literal: First year of Tai'an, spring, first month, day xinyou: the spirit tablets of Shizu and Gongzong were installed in the Grand Temple.
idiomatic: In the first month of spring of the first year of Tai'an, on the xinyou day, the spirit tablets of Shizu and Gongzong were installed in the Grand Temple.

literal: General of Chariots and Cavalry, Prince of Yueping Ba, was guilty and ordered to die.
idiomatic: Ba, General of Chariots and Cavalry and Prince of Yueping, was found guilty and ordered to die.

literal: Second month, day guiwei: Prince of Wuchang Ti died.
idiomatic: In the second month, on the guiwei day, Prince of Wuchang Ti died.

literal: Third month, day jihai: an edict said: "We now for the first time install the spirit tablets of Shizu and Gongzong in the Grand Temple, and moreover in the Western Park have offered sacrifice to the host of spirits.
idiomatic: In the third month, on the jihai day, an edict said, "We now for the first time install the spirit tablets of Shizu and Gongzong in the Grand Temple, and moreover in the Western Park have offered sacrifice to the host of spirits.

literal: We, with this great celebration, bestow feasts on the hundred officials, yet persons who have committed crimes alone immediately suffer execution—this is not how to nurture the host of living beings and show pity to the multitude.
idiomatic: With this great celebration we bestow feasts on the hundred officials, yet criminals alone immediately suffer execution. This is not how to nurture the living and show pity to the multitude.

literal: The teaching of the sages proceeds from what is near to what is far.
idiomatic: The teaching of the sages proceeds from what is near to what is far.

literal: Therefore King Wen of Zhou applied punishment beginning with his widowed wife, extending to his brothers, thereby governing the state and clan.
idiomatic: Therefore King Wen of Zhou applied punishment beginning with his widowed wife and extending to his brothers, thereby governing the state and clan.

literal: If transformation follows what is near, favor also ought to be thus.
idiomatic: If transformation follows what is near, favor ought to be the same.

literal: Let there be a partial amnesty in the capital for those below death in punishment."
idiomatic: Let there be a partial amnesty in the capital for those below death in punishment."

literal: Summer, sixth month, day renxu: an edict named the imperial son Hong; a partial amnesty in the capital; the era name was changed.
idiomatic: In the sixth month of summer, on the renxu day, an edict named the imperial son Hong; there was a partial amnesty in the capital and the era name was changed.

literal: Day guiyou: an edict said: "He who governs should, according to what is fitting, establish offices and raise the worthy to posts, so that high and low are at peace and the people have no resentment.
idiomatic: On the guiyou day an edict said, "He who governs should, according to what is fitting, establish offices and raise the worthy to posts, so that high and low are at peace and the people have no resentment.

literal: If offices are not held by the right men and the wicked and depraved hold position, then government and teaching decline to ruin.
idiomatic: If offices are not held by the right men and the wicked hold position, government and teaching decline to ruin.

literal: We think clearly on promotion and demotion to elevate the way of rule.
idiomatic: We must think clearly on promotion and demotion to elevate the way of rule.

literal: Now We send thirty men of the Secretariat, including Mu Fuzhen, to tour the provinces and commanderies and observe local customs.
idiomatic: Now we send thirty men of the Secretariat, including Mu Fuzhen, to tour the provinces and commanderies and observe local customs.

literal: On entering their territory, if farmers do not till and many fields lie waste, then corvée is not timely and labor power is wasted;
idiomatic: On entering their territory, if farmers do not till and many fields lie waste, corvée is not timely and labor is wasted;

literal: if the aged eat coarse vegetables and the young have no hemp or cotton clothing, then exactions are frequent and wealth is exhausted;
idiomatic: if the aged eat coarse food and the young have no clothing, exactions are frequent and wealth is exhausted;

literal: if lanes and hamlets are empty and many people have fled, then guidance is without method and favor is neglected;
idiomatic: if lanes and hamlets are empty and many have fled, guidance is without method and favor is neglected;

literal: if bandits go openly and robbery does not cease, then awe and prohibition are not set and punishment is lost;
idiomatic: if bandits go openly and robbery does not cease, awe and prohibition are not set and punishment is lost;

literal: if many slanders arise together, great and small lament, the good hide themselves, and flatterers and the wicked hold the road, then law is confused and government is benighted.
idiomatic: if slanders arise on every side, great and small lament, the good hide themselves, and flatterers hold the road, then law is confused and government is benighted.

literal: For all such cases, demote and execute them.
idiomatic: For all such cases, demote and execute them.

literal: Those skilled in government, praise and reward them.
idiomatic: Those skilled in government, praise and reward them.
